nom: SUNDAY RILEY C.E.O. Vitamin C Rich Hydration Moisturizing Cream

avis.texte: This has the exact amount of moisturizing and full of essential vitamins! Perfect for your face! Gentle, feels like silk, does not cause break-outs!
Product was pointed out by a sales associate named Rita. She was so knowledgeable about product. Knows her store inside and out. Helped me with several things. She is an ULTA TREASURE!!!

Received a sample size with an Ulta kit and couldn't wait to try this one. Unfortunately, I was immediately disappointed by the residue it left on my skin. You cannot use anything or over it. Because it'll leave flakes all over. Definitely cannot use this product under make up.
I use this every night on my arms and hands; it's so moisturizing! The affect lasts such a long time! I will be repurchasing!

I love this cream and use it every day. It is light to the touch and glides on easily. I only need to use a tiny bit. My face feels moist and hydrated without heaviness or stickiness. I also feel that my face looks brighter.

avis.titre: Very hydrating, not overly greasy and smells Fresh
avis.texte: A nice face cream that does the trick without being too greasy. Smells lovely too...

This cream has improved my skin tone and texture dramatically and minimizes wrinkles and age spots. I use as day cream. Not a surprise since its been proven for more than 30 years that properly processedvitamin C in skincare is absorbed into the skin.
Purchase this regularly. Definitely worth the money. I have recommended this to friends
Love love this product… my skin is so bright and tight! I will definitely buy again!

52/F - My combo skin soaks up the C.E.O. Vitamin C moisturizer. Phenomenal. My wrinkles thank you! It is thick and easy to spread. A little goes a long way. Great moisturizer to apply after active treatments, as well.
I use this moisturizer every morning along with their vitamin c serum. Hydrating and creates the best glow. Doesn't irritate my skin. I use it on my neck, chest, and backs of my hands too. Love it.

avis.titre: I will by this product until I can no longer afford to buy !
avis.texte: Fabulous results. Worth every penny of it. Would highly recommend it to anyone who cares about their skin. Feel and see a drastic difference.

avis.titre: Not for dry or sensitive skin
avis.texte: Long story short, this face cream has caused horrible burning to my skin when applying it. My face has also been drier than ever with a lot of flaking. I was really hoping to love this product and I really enjoy the scent, but that's the only positive I can think of. I wish I hadn't purchased this moisturizer a few months back so I could return it considering it's high priced tag. I would not recommend.

Have to agree with other reviews. I don't actually have overly sensitive skin, but this cream caused so much redness and flaking that I had to stop using this product after a week. If your skin is on the dryer side, you'll probably experience a burning sensation which is very unpleasant to say the least.

Absolutely Love!! I could tell after just 2 days of using this, it brightened up my skin. I love the smell also. I will say I use only at night. It's thicker than the Afterglow. I'm over 50 so I need the extra hydration. I highly recommend.
I have extremely dry face even though its pricey its so worth it! Makes my face feel brand new !!!

I use to use Sunday Rileys Tidal cream and loved it, it worked great, but it was discontinued unfortunately. I decided to try the Sunday Riley CEO, and it left my skin starting to flake very bad, and extremtly red. It was almost like putting rubber on my face. If you have sensitive and dry skin this product isnt for you.
It is very moisturizing and leaves a dewy look with my foundation
THE BEST - I am sold on this. So smooth, so thin, yet so effectful!

avis.titre: If you have sensitive skin be cautious
avis.texte: I used this in combination with the vitamin c and tumeric oil and my neck broke out down to my chest and parts on my face. It took a few days to show up and few days to go away. My face was very moisturized. I did not like the smell together.

avis.titre: C.E.O Vitamin C moisturizing cream by Sunday Riley
avis.texte: I love how this feels once it seeps in. It does work for me on bare skin right after washing and drying my face but i believe it goes on and seeps in much better when used following a toner that dampens your skin. It does not pill when I combine my other face products which is a huge pet peeve of mine. Overall I love this product but I can see how it may irritate very dry skin.

This has been my go to day cream for 5 years now. I had lots of discoloration and dullness, and my face was looking old. I started using this from an Ipsy bag promotion and I have been repurchasing it since. It works great to clear orange sallowness and moderate melasma. It moisturizes my desert dry 50+ skin all day. I have incredibly reactive skin, and this doesn't break me out or clog my pores. I will use this faithfully until I cannot find it anymore.
I understand why this was on sale.. did not see much of any results. Too expensive for not much pay off.
The fragrance in this made me breakout i should have read what was in this first then i looked up the reviews on yuka it scored a 47/100 rated poor

avis.titre: Is this my holy grail product? ￼
avis.texte: Bought it on a whim, but I am SO GLAD that I did. My very sensitive and dry winter skin loves this and drinks it right up. Well worth the price I only wish I had found this sooner.
This product has a soft fragrance and is very creamy. Sadly this along with other products i purchased from this line, have caused an extremely bad breakout on my face. I really wanted to like it.

avis.titre: Wonderful for my night time routine!
avis.texte: For my black women… if you want to even your skin tone, tackle hyperpigmentation, and hydrate your skin, this is the cream for you! I'll start by saying that I've always thought my skin was too sensitive for vitamin C products, but this was recommended by an Ulta rep and I could not be more thankful that he did! Now I realize that everyone's skin is different so if you're unsure start off with a small amount. He recommended that I use this at night. I also use the good genes lactic acid treatment, so after I apply a thin layer of good genes, I apply this to my face and neck. This is a very RICH cream so I only wear it at night so it can absorb overnight. I wake up in the morning and my skin truly THANKS me! Hope this helps!
Liked the creamy consistency, but broke out in hives the second day of using this. I've tried other vitamin c products and this is the first time I have experienced this
I really enjoy putting this cream on every morning and noticing the glow to my skin almost immediately. I also have dry skin and my skin loves this cream.
this sets well, doesn't enlarge your pores, i saw brightness in 3days of use. silky look on skin when using
Truly this stuff is amazing, so smooth and hydrating and brightens my skin! It is a staple in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Great, but took some time to figure out
avis.texte: I got a sample of this in an advent calendar and my fiancee bought a full size for my bday because I remembered liking it enough. Then I remembered. It left my face super greasy and made me break out. It smells amazing but my skin felt awful after. Maybe it was my skin, maybe it was my technique, maybe I just don't like how it's "supposed" to feel. Finally found a way to make this work beautifully for my skin! I've been taking a little bit and combining with my fave moisturizer and a hydrating serum. Then, I apply it to wet or damp skin almost immediately after cleansing. My acne is clearing up, my skin looks bright and soft as ever, I think it's even helping my acne scars a little bit! I would give it 5 stars, but my skin really, really hated it being put on dry skin, even if i just patted my skin dry right before applying. It just wouldn't absorb. I couldn't find anyone else applying to wet or damp skin, tutorials just said add to clean skin. I heard someone mention this technique by chance, gave it a go, and BAM! Never looking back!

I have recently noticed the cosmetic trend to SR products and was curious after reading reviews. CEO is a rich moisturizing cream and with aging skin with a lot of exposure to sun, I find soothing for a night cream. I have used it for a morning routine but that is sparingly since it is so rich and prefer a serum in the morning. CEO has a light scent and does blend into the skin even though it is rich and nourishing, Prefer as my new night cream. As for cost, it is expensive but honestly the entire cosmetic market has reached a new high so this is comparable to other higher end lines.

I really wanted to love this cream!! I was looking to try something with Vitamin C as its gentler then retinol, and wanted something to hydrate me during fall & winter. Unfortinately this prodict was not for me. I used it three times and unfortunately am experiencing an allergic reaction. I have sensitive skin so I'm not overly surprised, but sad because it is a nice rich cream that smells good. Be sure to patch test if you're sensitive — I wish I would have.

I got this in a sample bag set and I'm SO happy I didn't purchase this in full size. My skin is fairly sensitive and the scent in this is what I think is causing my skin to freak out. It's all red, dry, itchy, and have a few bumps where I didn't prior to using this. It's a shame companies feel the need to use fragrance where it just isn't needed.

Got this lil bad boy in a sample bag. Putting this on after a freshlg washed face feels so good and clean ??? I personally am not a fan of fragances on face products but on this one i dont mind it all. Its part of the fresh feeling. Very creamy and i will say it does give a glow.

avis.titre: Perfect to pair with the oil!
avis.texte: *gifted by Sunday Riley The Sunday Riley CEO Glow line is by far one of my favorite vitamin c lines on the market! The CEO Glow Facial Oil is something I consistently use at night, and I've been looking for the perfect moisturizer to pair it with. I guess I've found it!

I use this product after cleansing my face and applying toner. The moisturizing cream sinks into my skin leaving it with a beautiful glow. My skin is soft after application and in the morning. I'm on my second jar!

I really want to love the line. I have read the reviews and I like that the company thinks about the environment. I have only been using the line for three weeks. The first week, my skin had a reaction and this cream burned when I applied it. After about 10 days, I started using it again but it still burns. I'm only using the moisturizer once a day and see if my skin will get use to it.

I am addicted to C.E.O. Vitamin C Rich Hydration Cream! It is truly the only moisturizer I have found in my almost 63 years of being alive that actually lasts all day of working, hiking or doing nothing. My skin never feels dry or thirsty and the smell is divine!
I am in love with this cream. It makes my skin very silky, soft and glowing. I just love it!

avis.titre: I like it as my am moisturizer
avis.texte: I dont think its the most moisturizing lotion available, but it definitely works. I like the ingredients and consistency, and love the company, so im happy to have it in my morning morning! I usually apply CEO Afterglow afterward, just for a touch of additional moisturizing.
Smooth, creamy, smells nice, works great. I use it with the CEO glow facial oil.

avis.titre: No i return it after 2 days it make my eyes water for 2 hour
avis.texte: I was allergic it made my waters water really bad I tried it for 2 days

avis.titre: I hope it works well for you!
avis.texte: I really really wish I was able to continue to use this product. It made my skin feel the softest it has ever been but I think I'm allergic. While the softness is big plus after it settles into my skin I start getting itchy and it burns a bit. I think if you're not allergic it is a great face cream that definitely moisturizes!!
Yes it's thick, but I didn't find it to be moisturizing. The moisture lasts a very short amount of time in the winter. Waste of money.

I've been using this cream for years! I absolutely love it. I've tried other products but nothing compares to this. Makes my skin look healthy! I'm 45 and my face looks pretty darn good since I've been using this.
I have very dry skin and my face loves the Vitamin C rich hydration cream. It feels very nice going on and then sinks in immediately. This is a wonderful base for my tinted face cream.

For reference, I'm 42 with acne prone slightly sensitive skin, minimal signs of aging. I started off my skin journey with dry skin but after going through a bottle of this cream, my skin finally feels nourished! For transparency, I also use Drunk Elephant Framboos Glycolic Night Serum once weekly and Cerave daily face wash but i've been really bad about sticking with a routine with exception of this cream. I really look forward to putting this on every morning. It is beyond amazing. It has a very light citrus scent and smells delicious. And wow does it feel luxurious when you put it on! It really hydrates well and overall i feel like my skin looks so much better after having gone through a bottle. I have tried so many creams, from high end to drug store. Nothing compares to this one for me.

I love this moisturizer. It visibly reduces redness, is very rich without being overly so -- I often break out from richer moisturizers (looking at you FAB) but this one is great, leaves my skin soft without being greasy or breaking out. I will never understand why people write reviews saying "NEVER BUY THIS!!" when they clearly had an allergic reaction to it. There is ALWAYS a risk of having a bad reaction to ANY skincare product, that is why you're supposed to PATCH TEST. Your skin having a bad reaction does not mean that the product is bad, it's just a normal function of trying different products.

This moisturizer really irritates my skin to the point that I can't use it. Makes my face really red and itchy. I've used Sunday Riley products for over a year and this is the only item that has done that. I'm not sure why because I use the C.E.O oil but just a heads up. I do not have sensitive skin and have used Sunday Riley as my skincare routine for a long time.
Love this cream, it is all in one, moisture vitamins and feels light on the skin

Love this cream in the morning to use layered over my ceo serum and before makeup. Very hydrating while still being light, goes on smoothly and doesn't make my makeup pill. Makes my complexion even brighter than serum alone. Love it!
This is my favorite moisturizer. What more could you ask for? Deeply hydrating, brightening, so luxurious- I'm obsessed!

I'm not one to buy fancy face cream or oils until I found Sunday Riley. I have combo skin and this hydrates my skin without making it oily. The smell is divine!!! Can't get enough of this stuff. The only con is after you try it you'll be hooked. ;)
I tried a sample of this Vitamin C Brightening Serum, and for the next five days I had a severly red, puffy, inflamed and itchy face. It was awful!!

This cream has a rich & sumptuous texture & really moisturizes. I have very dry skin since menopause and this is perfect! It goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, & has a light scent. I returned the No. 7 Vitamin C Cream bc this is SO much better! LOVE!

I'm really enjoying using this! It has a wonderfully rich, luscious feel on the skin, plus it seems an ever, ever so light hint of orange scent….am I imagining that?! Was hoping that jar was bigger! I'm very happy with it.
Amazing moisturizer. Absolutely my favorite of all the expensive ones i have tried and i have tried MANY.
This vitamin C hydration cream was recommended to me by a cosmetician in Paris and I have used it ever since.
I have used several other Sunday Riley products and they are all amazing. If you are looking for a rich daily moisturizer that will have you glowing, this is it!

LOVING the C.E.O. Rich Hydration Cream--OMG; it IS rich; thick, hydrating, and lovely scented. This is my first time purchasing and using, and so far, so great. I've layered over/with a couple other products (hydrating and B-3 serums, and Good Genes), and it has mixed well.

avis.titre: CEO Vitamin C Rich Hydration Cream
avis.texte: So happy with this moisturizer. Smells divine. Using it everyday
The cream does not smell good. It is oily and overbearingly thick. Definitely not worth the price!
I've been using this for years and love it! It's very moisturizing but not too heavy and has done wonders diminishing dark spots on my face from my sun worshipping days. I definitely recommend!
A really great moisturizer that gives a nice glow especially during the cold months. I usually have really dry skin during the winter I use this once at night and literally lasts all day!
Love this cream. I have a rather dry skin and this cream hydrates my skin so beautifully!

avis.titre: Smells amazing & feel hydrated right away
avis.texte: Love the aroma on this, light citrus. Not too heavy, creamy texture and just perfect weight for my warmer TX climate. Great absorption & refreshing
This goes on like silk and leaves your skin looking and feeling fresh!

avis.titre: CEO after GLOW gel is a keeper.
avis.texte: This is very nice, light weight but moisturizing and gives nice glow. So far hasn't made me breakout as I have maturing acne prone skin.

O.Em.Geeee!! I am a face products JUNKIE. I've tried ALL the clean brands, all price ranges and have buckets and buckets of products I've used for years. Some are fine, some don't seem to work at all, but I keep using them because I know they're clean and must be better for my health (and skin). I discovered Sunday Riley on Good Morning America and purchased one product, just to try. LOVED it sooooo much after only 1 use I immediately purchased 5 more products. Love EVERYTHING about this brand. I mix this with the CEO Glow and it actually makes me GLOW which was what I've been looking for all along!
I've been using Sunday Riley for almost 6 months and by far, the BEST products I've used. I suffer from rosacea open pores, and sensitive skin; noticed a huge difference in my skin within two weeks.

avis.titre: STAY AWAY from this product! Will ruin your face
avis.texte: I bought several products from Sunday Riley. I started using the C.E.O Vitamin C cream and I can say is total garbage. Within a week I developed brown spots on my face on the cheeks, jaw line and around the ear. I am extremely upset to the point that I will be asking them to pay for me getting the brown spots removed. The other products I bought will go straight to the trash can. Terrible company first time I ever use a face cream that destroys your face. Several people have provided similar reviews on cream producing brown spots on face. Never again.

I really love Sunday Riley's All in One Lactic Acid serum, and was looking for a new cream to use at night. Within the first 24 hours of using this, my skin became super bumpy, red & irritated. My skin *feels* like an orange peel, and I'm still trying to get rid of the rash/breakout. Will be switching back to Clinique's Smart Repair cream moisturizer.

I have oily/ combination skin and I normally only use a serum during the daytime because most moisturizers are too heavy or leave me looking oily once I apply makeup. This one does not! It is very rich and very moisturizing, but once it absorbs you cannot see or feel it on the skin. It does take about 20 minutes to fully absorb before applying any other products or makeup, so give yourself a bit of time in your routine. I was afraid to try this one during the day but I'm so glad I did! On days that I go without makeup, my skin looks smooth and my pores look refined, almost as if I had applied a blurring primer. It has helped to soften pigmentation from sun damage. I normally get a lot of post-inflammatory pigmentation after a blemish. When I recently had a couple of blemishes, they barely left a mark and healed quickly because I was using this product. I love it! I love every Sunday Riley product I have tried, but I am truly blown away by this one. I am an esthetician and I've tried lots of products over the years. This is one for the books :) Note: This product does have a very strong smell. However it did not effect my rating whatsoever because I was so pleased with the result.
I am a huge fans of SR products CEO is fantastic and leaves a nice dewy finish but not greasy. Serum add a little boost. Can't live without.
I LOVE EVERYTHING SUNDAY RILEY! This cream leaves my skin so supple and soft. The scent is so fresh and not perfumy. Definitely worth the price tag.
I have been using this product for several weeks and love it. My skin feels and looks so much better! Thank you

I have only used this for a few days. I love how it smells and brightens my skin. I don't like how thick it goes on. Maybe this will work better for me during the colder months when my skin tends to be dryer.
This moisturizer is fantastic. I mix it with my liquid foundation for a light "tinted moisturizer" product. Doesn't feel heavy, but is high quality
This light moisturizer smells like real, fresh oranges. It's helped reduce the appearance of my sunspots and makes my skin clear and bright.
My face feels so fresh and amazing I'm so happy I bought this

avis.titre: I think my skin is probably ridiculous...
avis.texte: I received this product from a subscription box a few years ago. Used it right away. I was excited to try it. Mild stinging sensation on application. Went to bed. Woke up covered in hives, eyes swollen shut. If you are sensitive to citrus, AVOID. I have Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, so multiple sensitivities. If you have Normal skin and aren't ridiculously sensitive, the consistency was really lovely to apply and smelled great. I was sad it didn't work for me. Especially since I had gotten a bonus size sample for basically free.
This product is so amazing, it literally feels like a face mask. It does not roll off your face, it feels SUPER moisturizing & gives very fast results. Every time I use it I am in AWE.
This product is so amazing, it literally feels like a face mask. It does not roll off your face, it feels SUPER moisturizing & gives very fast results. Every time I use it I am in AWE.

I have skin that is on the dry side and I LOVE a thick moisturizer but this one did not play well with my skin at all. It's really thick to the point it doesn't seem to absorb. It is also mildly irritating.
The best moisturizer I have ever used. And I have used many of them. Nothing else will touch this face.
I love this super creamy moisturizer for my dry skin. It feels positively luxurious.

I really loved using this moisturizer and my skin loved it too! It is rich and leaves my skin bright and clear. I find I can use it in the AM & PM which helps save a few bucks. It smells great and it gives you that glow!

avis.titre: Burned Skin and caused horrible red bumpy rash
avis.texte: Used for 2 days and my skin looks and feels like a bright red itchy bumpy mess. I am miserable. Returning product.
This moisturizer is rich, luxurious, and gives skin a citrusy glow. Excellent, as all Sunday Riley products are.

This is actually my second jar of this fantastic cream. A little bit goes a long way and definitely helps aid in keeping my rosacea at bay. I like to use this in the sunnier months before my sunscreen to really help negate the effects of the sun. It's one of the best smelling face creams I've ever used. The texture is great and the absorption of the product is also fabulous. I will continue to use this in years to come and am actually quite interested in trying the newest version of this as well.

Horrible. I got a nasty forehead breakout immediately upon using this and still struggling with it. Do not recommend. Vegetable oil is also a highly inflammatory oil. Should not be used in such an expensive product.

I am in love with your new product ! The cream goes on smoothly, has a lovely "spa" scent..and I can feel it going to work immediately !!! C.E.O. Vitamin C Rich Hydration Cream has become one of my favorites...will definitely keep ordering !!!!!!

I used to use this moisturizer, and I don't know why I ever stopped. My skin had become extremely dry and flakey, so I recently reintroduced it to my routine, and my skin was literally happy in less than 2 days!! Flake free and brighter. Sunday Riley for the WIN!

I received this about a year ago in a subscription box. I fell in love with how it moisturized my skin and made it glow. Recently I was in need of a moisturizer, browsed a beauty website, saw SR and knew I had to purchase. I love this product. I hope the ingredients never change because I will replenish when needed.

Received a sample of this and have tried it about three times in the span of a few weeks, and every time I've put this on it breaks me out! I got little pimples and white heads all over my face. I saw a review on here saying they got a similar reaction and that this contains vegetable oil, so I'm pretty sure that's the culprit. I'm just going to use the remaining on my body.
It is a pleasure opening the container each time since it has a refreshing scent. I have been using this for three days and can see a difference. My skin seems brighter and more radiant.

avis.titre: 56 yrs old and my skin never looked so good!
avis.texte: Excellent product. Smells yummy and my older dry skin loves it!
Love everything about it, including the smell..my skin looks and feels amazing instantly
It's an amazing moisturizer and gives an all day glow to the face
